title: CURRENT V550 ATTITUDE-CLOUD CORRECTNESS & COMPLETENESS COURT

evidence.probe_method: Faithful executable micro-fixtures reproduce exact inspected pandas/state/metric operations; connector code inspection controls orchestration, eligibility, gating, checkpoint and replay findings.

material_implementation_defects: nonblank special/missing/routing response states can become cotravel content
normalized mutual information divides nats by bits
resume does not rehydrate cross-question attitude-cloud state
cardinality/mode gating occurs before state registration and can delete later lawful pairs
confirmed_no_defect_areas: D03 denominator arithmetic for a fixed emitted pair
support marking does not suppress an otherwise emitted positive-support pair
major_authority_gaps: normative survey-weight law for cloud diagnostics
whole-cloud replay proof for changed response substrates

findings.finding: Lawful ordered-pair coverage depends on processing order because current anchors compare only with previously stored candidates.
findings.effect: The emitted graph is a processing-order lower triangle of the lawful anchor x feature graph.

findings.finding: normalized_mutual_information uses mutual_info_score in nats and distribution_entropy in bits.
findings.effect: Perfect deterministic binary mapping reports 0.6931471805599453 instead of 1.0.

findings.finding: _prepare_attitude_cloud_frame ignores harmonized row-level substantiveness/missingness/routing flags and filters only blank normalized responses.
findings.effect: DK/refusal/IAP/not-asked/inapplicable/special codes can become the modal cotravel response cell.

findings.finding: Resume resets attitude-cloud state and skips completed questions without rehydrating their prepared frames.
findings.effect: Cross-boundary pairs disappear relative to fresh computation even with unchanged data and configuration.

findings.finding: should_emit_cloud_tables is evaluated before build_attitude_cloud_rows, so a gated question is never registered in state.
findings.effect: A gated feature can be absent from pair formation for later anchors, extending the gate beyond the current question's own output.

findings.finding: An empty attitude-cloud table is globally labeled disabled_until_cross_question_engine regardless of the actual empty/nonexecution cause.
findings.effect: Mode-off, threshold omission, no eligibility, no overlap, order loss and resume loss are not typed distinctly.

findings.finding: Output field mutual_information contains normalized mutual information rather than raw MI.
findings.effect: D03 fixes current executable meaning, but field naming can mislead consumers.

findings.finding: Normative survey-weight requirement for the attitude-cloud diagnostic lane is not established.
findings.effect: Current execution is wholly unweighted; D04 cannot invent a weighted law.

findings.finding: Lawful semantics for conflicting duplicate/repeated response rows and multiselect set/order representation are unresolved.
findings.effect: Current first-row collapse is executable fact and row-order sensitive, but no alternative ordering/set rule is authorized.

findings.finding: No modal-cell tie-breaking law is established.
findings.effect: Reverse-pair selected modal cells need not transpose when multiple cells share the maximum.

findings.finding: D03's current denominator law does not establish whether routed eligibility should instead use a common risk-set denominator.
findings.effect: Current lift can mix response availability/routing with response cotravel under differential observability.

findings.finding: Current directional-atom cloud law is restricted to certified scalar and binary_contrast topology.
findings.effect: Nominal, multiselect, ranked/routed, derived/reference, administrative/missingness, and structural matrix-child topologies are not lawful current cloud inputs.

findings.finding: Fixed-pair denominator arithmetic matches D03's exact oracle.
findings.effect: Anchor-only responders missing B remain in n_anchor; candidate baseline uses all prepared B responders.

findings.finding: _ATTITUDE_CLOUD_STATE key includes run_id, source, wave, canonical_wave and country_code.
findings.effect: Respondent-ID collisions across requested scopes cannot join.

findings.finding: Positive low-N selected cells are emitted and marked by support/confidence tiers rather than suppressed.
findings.effect: Support status does not change probability/association computation.

findings.finding: Persistent cloud rows retain only one modal joint response cell plus pairwise NMI/Cramer's V.
findings.effect: Rare nonmodal category-specific cells are not individually preserved even though full-table association summaries see them.

question_order.lawful_pair_set: {(A,B) | A != B and anchor_eligible(A) and feature_eligible(B)}
question_order.current_fresh_pair_set: {(Qi,Qj) | j < i and anchor_eligible(Qi) and feature_eligible(Qj)} subject to other gates

respondent_overlap.n_overlap_semantics: selected modal joint-cell count, not total joined respondents
respondent_overlap.complete_case_universe: inner join used for cross-tab/NMI/Cramer's V

baseline_denominator.p_given: N_ab / N_a over full prepared anchor frame
baseline_denominator.p_baseline: N_b / N_B over full prepared candidate frame

routing_missingness.physically_absent_candidate_row: excluded from join; anchor can remain in n_anchor

validator_audit.conclusion: Current validation cannot certify D03 pair completeness or several D04 semantic invariants.

pair_coverage.ruling: Current output is a processing-order lower-triangular projection of the lawful ordered-pair graph; dual-eligible A/B proves unavoidable incompleteness.

order_invariance.ruling: Permuting question processing order changes the emitted ordered-pair set.

directional_semantics.ruling: A->B and B->A are distinct when both are lawful; conditional fields are directional while NMI/Cramer's V are symmetric.

denominator.ruling: Current fixed-pair denominators exactly match D03; routed common-risk-set semantics remain missing authority.

weighting.ruling: Current cloud is entirely unweighted; D04 found no authority requiring or authorizing a particular weighted replacement.

duplicate_multiselect.ruling: First-row collapse is row-order sensitive for conflicting duplicates; exact duplicates can be harmlessly collapsed; multiselect is not a current supported cloud topology.

routing_missingness.ruling: Explicit nonblank special/non-substantive response states can become cotravel content because cloud preparation ignores harmonized epistemic/routing flags.

scope_isolation.ruling: run/source/wave/canonical_wave/country are all present in the state key, isolating respondent-ID collisions across those scopes.

cloud_gating_completeness.ruling: A gated question is not registered into cross-question state, so gating can delete later lawful pairs; omission reason is not typed in final empty status.

replay_equivalence.ruling: Per-question resume is provably non-equivalent because skipped questions do not rehydrate state. Whole-cloud replay has stronger guards but does not itself prove response-substrate identity or pair-set completeness.

implementation_defects: special response states treated as content
pre-state cloud gating deletes later pairs
validators do not certify pair completeness
mathematical_object_limitations: one modal joint cell persisted rather than full pairwise joint distribution
directional event denominator is not complete-case
pairwise NMI/Cramer's V are lossy summaries
rare nonmodal cells are not persisted individually
support tiers mark rather than suppress
population cotravel is not actor psyche/belief/identity
